title: Tampa Cooking Class in a Local Home - BBQ, Mexican or Brunch
includes: Private cooking class with your host Eric
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
policies: If any travelers in your party have any allergies, dietary restrictions or cooking preferences please advise at time of booking
Menu may vary depending on the season
Vegetarian, vegan and gluten free option is available, please advise at time of booking if required
Please choose one from the four menu options available: Mexican Fiesta or American BBQ or Seafood or Sunday Brunch (only available on Sundays, lunch time)
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a private and authentic cooking class in a local Tampa home with your host, Eric. Eric has been a home cook with over 40 years’ experience - cooking started out as a necessity and over the years became a huge source of joy. He is a firm believer in preparing his meals with lots of love and care as everyone deserves great food and drink - it is good for the soul! 

You will be welcomed with a smile into Eric and Nancy’s beautiful, warm and spacious home, which is 30-45 mins away from Clearwater, St Petersburg and Disney in Florida. Join Eric in his open home kitchen for a hands-on cooking class. Learn to make 2 dishes from scratch, depending on the menu you choose. After cooking, join the couple to share the meal that you helped prepare.

• Cooking lesson and meal in a local home
• Introduction to a new culture and cuisine
• 100% private activity
• Eric can accommodate all special dietary needs, however, you need to inform him in advance, while booking the experience online
